newsitem.title: CHINA: Shanghai New Asia 96 net down 3.48 pct.
newsitem.headline: Shanghai New Asia 96 net down 3.48 pct.

text.p: (in millions of yuan unless stated, against 1995 figures)
Net asset per share 2.46 yuan vs 2.22 yuan
Earnings per share 0.246 yuan vs 0.228 yuan
Company name: Shanghai New Asia (Group) Co Ltd.
Note: The results were published in a company statement. The net profit numbers are based on international accounting standards, other figures are based on domestic accounting standards.
Based on domestic accounting standards, the 1996 net profit was 87.411 million yuan against 76.572 million yuan in 1995.
The company's board of directors proposed a cash dividend of 0.1 yuan per share, a two-for-10 bonus issue and a three-for-10 rights issue pending shareholders' approval, the statement said.
